package arrays;
import java.util.Scanner;
public class EquilibriumIndex {

	public static void main(String[] args) {
		// TODO Auto-generated method stub
Scanner sc=new Scanner(System.in);
int n=sc.nextInt();
int a[]=new int[n];

for(int i=0;i<n;i++) {
	a[i]=sc.nextInt();

}
for(int i=0;i<n;i++) {
	int leftsum=0;
	int rightsum=0;
	for(int j=0;j<i;j++) {
		leftsum+=a[i];
	}
	for(int j=i+1;j<n;j++) {
		rightsum+=a[i];
	}

	
		if(leftsum==rightsum) {
			System.out.print(i);
		return;
	
	}
}
System.out.println("No equilibrium index");

sc.close();

	}
}
/*Example:

[1, 3, 5, 2, 2]

At index 2:

1  3  [5]  2  2
← left   right →

Left sum:

1 + 3 = 4

Right sum:

2 + 2 = 4

So:

//Equilibrium Index = 2
*/
